wholePhysicalScope: The mapped mill and kiln are joined by the covered passage. Their footprint, May 2008 photographs and listed-building description fix the rubble walls, leaning kiln, red pantiles, covered connector, and wheel over the southern mill lade.
lodDetails: All four authored levels preserve the rectangular mill, leaning conical kiln, linked passage, wheel and mapped lade. Near levels add pantile ridges, masonry and wheel detail.
limitations: Spring 2008 exterior. The wheel and sluice are static. The visitor building, nearby millpond and separate doocot are outside the model.
Roof pitch, detailed rubble, kiln lean, sill elevations and the lade section are approximate where the photographs and mapped outlines leave gaps.
Original terrain samples remain unchanged. A small ground opening follows the wheel channel beneath the modeled section of mill lade.
